title: Grid to pixels
prompt: The robot's grid has cells 64 pixels wide and tall. Return the pixel position of the top-left corner of the cell at the given column and row. Column 2, row 1 is (128, 64).
starter:
func grid_to_pixels(column, row) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(column, row)
hints: Make a vector from the column and row, then scale it.

docs.name: Vector2(x, y)
docs.what: Makes a vector holding an x and a y. Read them back with .x and .y.

docs.name: a + b, a - b, v * number, v / number
docs.what: Vectors add and subtract part by part, and scale by a plain number.

solution:
func grid_to_pixels(column, row) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(column, row) * 64
